tasks.title: Write an Email
tasks.instruction: Write an email. In your email, do the following:
tasks.prompt: You have been selected to represent your university at an international conference. You need to inform your professor, Dr. Lee, about this opportunity and request permission to miss class during the conference. Write an email to Dr. Lee.
bullets: Inform Dr. Lee about the opportunity, including conference topic and location.
Request permission to miss class and suggest ways to make up for missed classes.
Ask for suggestions on how to prepare for the conference.
tasks.subject: Attending international conference
